finding: Audio references can escape the selected run
disposition: Central path policy plus descriptor-relative no-follow regular-file opens bind ASR to a verified stream under the canonical evidence directory. Negative controls cover traversal, absolute outsiders, links, nonregular files and a post-admission file swap.

finding: Historical AllTalk default versus explicit voices
disposition: Shipped defaults now use alloy. The adapter maps only inherited ALLTALK_TTS_VOICE_DEFAULT=female_01.wav to alloy. The historical Studio sentinel remains female_01.wav so untouched saved configuration inherits without an exact override or write. Store-to-effective-resolution tests verify that path and preservation of changed narrator.wav; request-level tests preserve all explicit voice IDs. The stale review assertion that the historical sentinel is migrated as a changed value is contradicted by the migration comparison and tests. No supported native-filename-to-alias identity mapping exists for the pinned alias endpoint, so explicit selections are not silently remapped.
The active Settings picker uses the shared official Kokoro catalog. Mounted tests select representative voices across all nine languages without writing blend configuration.
